attribution.title: Monkey in the Kitchen
attribution.author: Prabakaran Sadagopan
attribution.modified: テキスト抽出・画像リサイズ・JSON 正規化を実施

pages.text: A mother went to attend to her child who fell in the bath room. A monkey came into the kitchen. It ate some mangoes. When the mother returned she noticed some mangoes are missing. She asked her child, "did you eat the mangoes? " . She ran out and saw the monkey. Then she realized it is not her child who ate, it is the monkey.
